tagline: Community banking footprint spans across the Rocky Mountain, Pacific Northwest, and Midwest regions of the U.S.
hero_kpi_rationale: The company's total assets are a key indicator of its size and reach in the banking sector, reflecting its ability to serve a diverse customer base and finance significant operations.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company, including cash, loans, and investments.
kpis.description: Represents the total value of economic resources controlled by the company.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the bank's size and scale.

kpis.name: Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of funds deposited by customers with the bank.
kpis.description: Indicates customer trust and the bank's funding base.
kpis.signal: Primary source of funding for lending activities.

kpis.name: Loans Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Total value of loans originated by the bank and held to maturity.
kpis.description: Represents the bank's loan portfolio intended to generate interest income.
kpis.signal: Primary generator of interest income for the bank.

kpis.name: Total Stockholders Equity
kpis.explanation: Net worth of the company, representing assets minus liabilities.
kpis.description: Represents the residual value of the company's assets after deducting all debts.
kpis.signal: Indicator of financial strength and value for shareholders.

kpis.name: Banking Offices
kpis.explanation: Total number of physical branches operated by the bank.
kpis.description: Represents the bank's physical branch network.
kpis.signal: Indicates geographic presence and customer accessibility.

kpis.short: Indirect Loans as % of Consumer Loans
kpis.name: Indirect Loans as % of Consumer Loans
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consumer loans that are indirect loans (purchased from dealers).
kpis.description: Measures the proportion of indirect loans within the consumer loan portfolio.
kpis.signal: Indicates a strategic exit from the indirect lending market.

kpis.short: Loans Sold in Credit Card Outsourcing
kpis.name: Loans Sold in Credit Card Outsourcing
kpis.explanation: Amount of consumer credit card loans sold as part of an outsourcing transaction.
kpis.description: Amount of loans transferred upon the sale of the credit card portfolio.
kpis.signal: One-time transaction impacting the loan portfolio.

kpis.name: Gain on Credit Card Outsourcing
kpis.explanation: Profit realized from the sale of consumer credit card loans.
kpis.description: Net profit generated from the outsourcing of the credit card portfolio.
kpis.signal: Positive financial impact of a strategic transaction.

kpis.name: Indirect Loans
kpis.explanation: Consumer loans purchased from auto, boat, and other dealers, representing their share of the total loan portfolio.
kpis.description: Represents the share of indirect loans in the overall loan portfolio.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in indirect loan exposure following the cessation of origination in February 2025.

kpis.name: Deposits from Branch Sale
kpis.explanation: Amount of deposits transferred in connection with the sale of eleven bank branches in Nebraska to Security First Bank.
kpis.description: Deposits associated with branches sold to Security First Bank, pending closing in Q2 2026.
kpis.signal: Impact of asset divestiture on deposit base following the strategic transaction.

kpis.name: Loans from Branch Sale
kpis.explanation: Amount of loans transferred in connection with the sale of eleven bank branches in Nebraska to Security First Bank.
kpis.description: Loans associated with branches sold to Security First Bank, pending closing in Q2 2026.
kpis.signal: Impact of asset divestiture on loan portfolio following the strategic transaction.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to numerous federal and state regulations, and changes in these regulations could negatively impact its business. References to shifts in CFPB priorities and increasing supervisory intensity highlight the significance of this risk.

risks.title: Tax Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex tax laws and regulations and is exposed to audits and penalties in case of non-compliance. Changes in tax laws could also negatively affect its business.

risks.title: Capital Requirements
risks.score_rationale: Regulators could impose stricter capital requirements, which could negatively impact the company's profitability. Changes in capital rules could also affect its operations.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational risk in the event of non-compliance with laws and regulations, which could negatively impact its business and profitability.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly due to increasing reliance on information technology. Cybersecurity attacks could negatively impact its operations and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: The company FIBK does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. There is no indication of its involvement in the AI field.
